name: Quét vòng quanh người
desc: a WEAPON swung level with the ground through a FULL turn round the body (360 degrees) seen from the game's camera: a flat ring, the near half in FRONT of the character, bright and thick, the far half BEHIND it, cool and thin; the head runs the circle in about a second (u falls: from the left, across the front to the right, behind the body and back to the left); use it with the body centre as --from and --to = a point at the weapon's reach on the side of the first position; set k, u0, u1 and r with --swing when the real path differs

warn: linger: the last 20 of 50 frames carry under 2 % of the peak
empty0: the first frame is empty
